snippet.title: HOW TO ESCAPE DIAMOND ELO IN LEAGUE OF LEGENDS
snippet.description:
How to escape diamond 

How to escape low diamond 

If you are between plat 2 and diamond 3 elo this video is gonna help you get out of elohell (d4 elo) 

1. Look up your teammates op.gg every single champion select and make sure people are not first timing a champion in ranked 
People in d4 tend to give up tryharding since they made it to diamond and they know that they can´t reach masters so they just start trolling in ranked since it´s really hard to demote from d4

2. I highly suggest getting a duo 
It´s really hard to solo carry in low diamond since people tend to give up early game and has bad macro 

3. Sometimes press S and stand still and let your teammates die if they are going for a dumb play, don´t try to help them out and give the enemy 2 kills instead of only 1 

4. Only commit to calls where you are all 5 going for that call or if are sure you can win by following this call even if people are not all comming 

5. Don´t give up if you lose early since a lot of diamond 4 players tend to throw from ahead 

6. /Mute all since people tilt super hard and will share their frustrations and try to frustrate and tilt you even though you are on the same team you can keep pings if you want

How to stop autopiloting

What is autopiloting 

In the video game industry autopiloting means that you are not 100% focused on the game and you play at your 60-70% performance 

1. Don´t listen to music in the background while playing 

2. Don´t have any youtube videos/streams running on your 2nd monitor or in the back ground 

3. Sit properly with good posture 

4. Don´t spam games play a few amount of games but focus on those games 

5. don´t text anyone on discord or on your phone

Basically don´t be distracted but focus fully on the game

snippet.title: HOW TO OFFTILT STAY CALM BEFORE DURING AND AFTER THE GAME
snippet.description:
This video is about how to stay calm before you get into game what type of mindset you should have and what your expectations should be while also realizing what reality really is aswell as how to stay calm during the game and how to off tilt after a very frustrating game 

Follow me on my socials: 
Socials 
Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/kami_khazix
Twitter: https://twitter.com/KamiEUW
Insta: https://www.instagram.com/kami_khazix/
Discord: https://discord.gg/59pePV5

Everyone tilts for different reasons, and everyone offtilts in different ways

But here are some of my offtilt methods and sugestions that you can try out if you are having issues with tilting in-game 

First up there are some things that you can do before the game starts to make sure that you don´t tilt 
1. Don´t expect your teammates to perform well or rely on your teammates
If you have low expectations, you won´t get upset about your teammates perform bad, and if they perform well it´s a good thing 
2, Realize that you are in an elo where there are bad players
3. Every single game there will be mistakes both that you make yourself, your team makes and enemy team makes


If you then have a bad game or tilt from team mates performing bad there are some stuff that you can do in game 
1. /mute all at the start of the game (I suggest keeping pings) 
2. Find your teams win condition and focus on that win condition 
3. Find a way to comeback into the game, wait for enemy team to throw and punish them for it 

if you come out of the game and you are still tilted here are my suggestions to offtilt 
1. Go eat 
2. Watch a youtube video, stream, series or movie 
3. Take a shower 
4. Go for a short work out session 
5. Go outside for a walk 

DONT INSTANTLY QUE UP TO A NEW GAME AND BE TILTED FROM THE START OF THE GAME 

You need to reset your mindset and forget about last game especially if it was a tilting game no matter if you won or lost that game

snippet.title: How to prepare for ranked games
snippet.description:
How to prepare for a ranked game 

Here is a list of things you should be doing before you head into ranked espesially if you are gonna be playing multiple ranked games in a row 

1. Make sure you don´t have cold hands 
If you are a player like me who suffers from cold hands it is really important that you either 1. get some blod flowing into your hands or 2. warm them by either getting hand warmers or warm a glass of water 

2. Test your mechanics with warm up game modes such as mobalytics playground or lol dodge game 

lol dodge game website: https://loldodgegame.com/
mobalytics playground website: https://pg.mobalytics.gg/

3. Be sure that you are mentally okay (that you are not having a bad day and that nothing negative is happening) 

4. Make sure that you have water with you to stay hydrated 

5. Make sure that you are not playing on an empty stomach 

All of these things can be done by everyone and will be helpful on your grind in league or any other game actually

snippet.title: How to escape platinum elo
snippet.description:
This video is me talking about the mistakes that I see in platinum elo 

I have been playing on a platinum 2 account wih 70% winrate on EUW 

I have been playing in plat 2 plat 1 and diamond 4 mmr recently 

The mistakes are as follows:
People in platinum tend to give up if they fall behind in early game so /mute all and dont type in chat since this will only make the game even worse 

Laners doesn´t look at jungle pathing and doesn´t respect jungle pressure (laners should look where enemy jungler starts, and play passively when enemy jungler is on their side of the map) 

In high platinum plat 2 plat 1 elo if you have d4 players look up peoples op.gg and see if people are first timing champions since a lot of diamond players starts to not tryhard after hitting diamond 

People should play more for rift herald in the early game instead of focusing on the first 2x drakes since rifts give more gold than drakes 

People should itemize against specific champions for an example executioners calling and morello and bramble vest versus healing champions 

People should read patch notes a lot of people don´t keep up to date with reworks, item updates and what´s in the meta

Smaller champion pool stop trying to use high elo strategies in lower elo

snippet.title: (ENG) 10 Tips & Tricks for Kha Zix that beginners might not know about
snippet.description:
Kha tips: 

1. Passive unssen threat reset when ever going into unwarded bush
2. You can Tiamat + Q mid air if E is evolved
3. Your Q gets 50+ bonus range when evolved 
4. Your Q is extended when mid air if E is evolved
5. Whenever kha is in ulti he is ignoring unit collision which means he can´t be minion blocked
6.  Kha Zix W evolved gives sight of enemies 
7.  Your passive also slows which means your combo will look like this: aa + passive with slow + Q 
8. Your ulti can cancel targeted abilities such as Darius ulti if timed correctly 
9. Flash will cancel your E jump so use Flash then E not the opposite way around 
10. Your Q is not an auto attack so you can still Q things such as Pantheon with passive block Jax with E counter strike active 

Bonus tip: 
Animation cancel on W after you have landed with e

snippet.title: (ENG) Evolve order on Kha Zix Jungle
snippet.description:
What to evolve as Kha Zix jungle in different scenarious 

Recently I have been asked so many times about my evolve order and why I evolve as I do, I have always said that the evolve order on kha zix is situational, but never really gone in depth on what situational really means. 

Thats why I made this video about the evolve order on Kha Zix Jungle 

First a walk through on What the different abilites does when they are evolved 

Then going on to what to evolve depending on what situation you are in 

And last but not least give you some specific champions and abilites that counters the different evolutions 

If you wan´t to know what my typical evolve order is, then it is Q at lvl 6, W at lvl 11 and E at lvl 16. 

Though this evolve order is not always the best and that´s why I made this video, to give you guys some what of an idea on what to evolve at what point or stage in the game. 

Mainly E and R are the evoulutions that can get countered. 

E evolve is getting countered by cc, such as Poppy´s W, Veigar´s E or Janna´s Q and R while R evolve is getting countered by champions who can reveal stealth, such as Lee sin with his Q and E or Twisted Fate with his R. 

If you are against some of theese champions you might want to evolve in a different way that you usually do :) 

With all that said, feel free to leave a like on this video if this was helpful for you and leave a comment either in the comment section below or on my stream if you are wondering about something or you disagree or you just feel like i missed something

snippet.title: (ENG) 3 different jungle clear pathings as Kha Zix Jungle
snippet.description:
First clear: 

If you are on (blue side) 
Start Hunter´s Talisman + Refillable potion 
1. Red 
2. Raptors
3. Scuttle 
4. Gank mid/bot or go to wolves
5. Wolves
6. Gromp
7. Gank Top/mid or recall and go back to bot side jungle 

Second clear: 
If you are on (red side) 
Start Hunter´s Machete + refillable potion
1. Blue 
2. Gromp
3. Scuttle 
4. Wolves
5. Red 
6. Gank or recall

Third clear: 
1. Red 
2. Krugs 
3. Top scuttle 
4. Gank or invade enemy blue buff

snippet.title: (ENG) Electrocute vs Dark Harvest on Kha Zix
snippet.description:
A walkthrough of the Electrocute vs Dark Harvest on Kha Zix situation 

Taking examples from me and Damir 

I personally think electrocute is the best option on kha most of the time, while Damir always runs Dark Harvest on Kha Zix 

This video is not made to convince you that Electrocute is best 

This video is totally based on my opinion 

I recommend trying out both mine and Damir´s build + rune setup before you make a conclusion yourself on what keystone is the best on Kha Zix
